title: Office relocation notice
passage:
Dear colleagues,

Our customer service team will move to the third floor on April 12. Please label each box with your name and desk number so that the movers can place it [143] ____.

Personal valuables should be carried by their owners. The moving company is responsible only [144] ____ packed office equipment and files. [145] ____

On moving day, incoming calls will be handled by our regional office. Normal telephone service at this site will [146] ____ at 9 a.m. the following morning. Thank you for your cooperation.

客服團隊將於四月十二日搬到三樓。請在每個箱子上標示姓名與桌號，讓搬運人員能 [143] ____ 放置。

個人貴重物品應由物主自行攜帶。搬家公司僅 [144] ____ 已裝箱的辦公設備及檔案負責。[145] ____

搬遷當天，來電將由區域辦公室處理。本辦公室的正常電話服務將於隔天上午九點 [146] ____。感謝各位配合。
